svg.text: COPPER SIDE, mirrored: what you see when you cut the tracks
CASE open unless the case is bonded
AVDD open until the AVDD-ISO cut
VIN shunt fitted: Pi 5 V to VIN
32 × 36 holes · cut to 81.3 × 91.4 mm · 47 cuts · 57 links · 2 standoff holes (2.5 mm, for M2.5 nylon standoffs)
The converter — and the audio star.
M1 WM8960 — GND at the top of each row, as on the SparkFun board
U3 78L05 — legs down the column: OUT, GND, IN. Flat face to the left
Connectors (pin 1 is the large filled square)
D2 → Core breakout, Molex KK 254 14-way: 1 GND · 2 BCLK · 3 GND · 4 LRCLK
(DACLRC) · 5 GND · 6 ADCDAT · 7 GND · 8 DACDAT · 9 GND · 10 SDA · 11 SCL ·
A4 → Input buffer, JST-XH 4-way (B4B-XH-A): 1 GND · 2 LIN1 · 3 GND · 4 +9 V
A5 → Output L, JST-XH 3-way (B3B-XH-A): 1 GND · 2 HPL · 3 —
A6 → Output R, JST-XH 3-way (B3B-XH-A): 1 GND · 2 HPR · 3 —
A10 → Mic preamp (later), JST-XH 4-way (B4B-XH-A): 1 GND · 2 RIN1 · 3 GND ·
P1 → 9 V power, JST-XH 2-way (B2B-XH-A): 1 GND · 2 +9 V
VIN shunt fitted: Pi 5 V to VIN: 1 Pi 5 V · 2 VIN · 3 78L05
AVDD open until the AVDD-ISO cut: 1 78L33 · 2 AVDD
CASE open unless the case is bonded: 1 GND · 2 case
DGND reaches the root through D2 only (Core breakout).
AGND reaches the root through D2 only (Core breakout).
D2 is a single-row Molex KK header, which is what the strips can hold. Its
grounds go to the codec’s digital pins and nowhere on the analogue bus.
The VIN shunt is drawn linking the Pi’s 5 V to VIN, which is how the board
is brought up. Move it onto the 78L05 for 2c’s first leg. Leave the AVDD
shunt open until the AVDD-ISO cut is made.
The case bond is open. It is the only place the case may touch, and only
OUT3 is not connected. Never ground it.

Red ✕: cut the track at that hole (red bar: cut between two holes). Lines: wire links on the component side (green carries ground). Strips tinted green carry ground, red a supply, amber 3.3 V. White circles: standoff holes; dashed: what the standoff covers.
